title: Customer requests reimbursement of a guaranteed-delivery surcharge after confirmed delay

plan.situation: Nella Voss's guaranteed-delivery parcel DL-050 was due by 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC but was handed over at 08:40 UTC, 40 minutes late. The carrier's route record gives the cause as a carrier sorting delay. She has asked the desk to submit a request for the GBP 7.50 guarantee surcharge. Under the booking terms the surcharge may be credited only after Plover Arc Logistics billing has reviewed it, so the next step is a billing-review request to the carrier.

facts.fact: DL-050 was guaranteed for delivery by 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC with a GBP 7.50 surcharge
If a carrier-caused delay is confirmed, the surcharge may be credited after billing review
Route record: carrier sorting delay; actual recipient handover 2026-03-23 08:40 UTC
Handover was 40 minutes after the guaranteed time
Customer asks the desk to submit a request for the GBP 7.50 surcharge
The guarantee covers only the surcharge, subject to billing approval

missing_information: Billing review outcome and any credit reference from Plover Arc Logistics billing
Billing team's turnaround date for the review
risk_flags: money: the credit is limited to the recorded GBP 7.50 surcharge; no other compensation may be claimed or promised
Hard human gate: the draft asks for a credit of an amount, so it waits for human approval before it is sent
No payment links and no card or bank details may be requested

authority_map.party: Plover Arc Logistics billing (via Service guarantees)
authority_map.controls: Whether to credit the GBP 7.50 surcharge after billing review
Making the claim; receives the outcome
Submitting the request only; has no pre-authorisation to credit any amount

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: First request from the customer (event 002); the desk has made no earlier promise

plan.decision_summary: Ask Plover Arc Logistics billing, by email, to review a credit of the GBP 7.50 guarantee surcharge on DL-050. The draft is held for human approval because it asks for a credit of an amount.
plan.rationale: The carrier's own record confirms a carrier-caused delay (40 minutes past the guarantee) and records no exclusion. The booking terms send any credit through billing review. So carrier billing is the owner of this decision, and the request is for the recorded surcharge only.

actions.subject: DL-050 – request for billing review of GBP 7.50 guarantee surcharge credit
actions.purpose: Ask the owner of the decision (carrier billing) to review the surcharge credit
actions.body:
Hello,

Please put DL-050 through billing review for a credit of the guaranteed-delivery surcharge, under the booking terms you sent on 2026-03-23 at 09:00 UTC.

- Guaranteed by: 2026-03-23 08:00 UTC
- Actual recipient handover (your route record): 2026-03-23 08:40 UTC, 40 minutes late
- Recorded cause: carrier sorting delay; no exclusion recorded
- Amount requested: GBP 7.50 (the recorded surcharge only)

The customer, Nella Voss, asked us to submit this request on 2026-03-23 at 09:10 UTC. Please confirm the review outcome, and if a credit is approved, send the credit note reference. Please also tell us when you expect to complete the review.

This is a request for review, not a confirmation that a credit is due.

Iona Quill
Rivet Delivery Desk

actions.purpose: Record the step and the approval gate
actions.body: Billing-review request drafted to Service guarantees, Plover Arc Logistics for the GBP 7.50 surcharge on DL-050 (handover 08:40 UTC against an 08:00 UTC guarantee; 40 minutes late; carrier sorting delay; no exclusion). Hard gate: needs human approval before sending. Nothing has been promised to the customer.

actions.purpose: Same-working-day check under the billing_review queue rule
actions.body: Check whether Plover Arc Logistics billing has replied with a review outcome, a credit note reference or a review date for the DL-050 surcharge. If they have given a date, move the next check to that date. If there is no reply, chase on the same email thread.

not_doing: Not promising the customer a refund or credit: billing has not confirmed one
Not claiming more than GBP 7.50 or any other compensation: the guarantee covers only the surcharge
Not sending a payment link or asking for card or bank details
Not sending a separate customer update now: there is no cutoff; the customer will be told the outcome once billing confirms it, through the Customer portal
plan.follow_up: Check for billing's reply at 2026-03-23 17:00 UTC. If billing gives a review date, follow up on that date. If there is no reply, chase on the same email thread. Once a credit note reference is received, update Nella Voss through the Customer portal, saying it is a credit (not cash) and giving only the confirmed amount.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Ask Plover Arc Logistics billing, by email, to review a credit of the GBP 7.50 guarantee surcharge on DL-050. The draft is held for human approval because it asks for a credit of an amount.

issues.problem: Nella Voss asked the desk to submit the request, but the plan doesn't tell her when it has been sent. The only customer update is planned for after billing confirms the outcome, so she won't know her request is in progress.
issues.fix: Optional: once the human approves and the email is sent, send a short portal note telling her the request has gone to carrier billing for review. Don't give any outcome or timing.

issues.problem: The policy lint flagged the words 'guarantee' and 'guaranteed'. These are false positives: the words name the service and its booked deadline and don't promise any outcome.

review.summary: The plan is correct. It sends the request for the GBP 7.50 surcharge only to Plover Arc billing, the party that decides it, using the verified email channel. Every fact and calculation comes from event 001, and the 40-minute delay is right. The plan doesn't promise a credit, holds the draft for human approval, and the follow-up is sensible. The two minor points need no change before sending.
